derived_rank19_inose_model.genericity_condition: s^3 is neither 0 nor 1, and s avoids the countable Noether-Lefschetz jumping set
derived_rank19_inose_model.argument: The two II* fibers and one I2 fiber give the rank-19 trivial lattice. The marked fiber configuration varies with s^3, so the family is non-isotrivial. The generic member therefore has rho=19 off the Noether-Lefschetz jumping set; Shioda-Tate gives MW rank zero, and the discriminant-2 trivial lattice has no proper even overlattice.

classification_boundary.source: Artebani-Hausen-Laface Theorem 2.12, based on Nikulin and Vinberg
classification_boundary.consequence: The full nef/root chamber of a finite-automorphism complex projective K3 has hyperbolic dimension at most 18, and dimension 18 is attained. This is not an obstruction to irrational eigenspace slices or to Coxeter polytopes not arising as full K3 nef chambers.

novelty_statement: The five lattices, curve graphs, and finite automorphism groups are published examples, not new Coxeter polytopes. The potentially new contribution is the intrinsic intersection-Hessian/Cox-ring interpretation and their use as exact high-dimensional calibration objects for algebraic inverse design.
